verdict.rationale: Fireflies exposes a documented GraphQL API (bearer-token auth) with transcript/action-item queries that a developer or agent could use to push action items into an external tracker, and MCP servers exist for docs/data access, but there is no evidence of native, first-party integrations, webhooks, or automations targeting Linear, Jira, or Asana specifically. missing for 10: documented webhooks, native Linear/Jira/Asana connectors, or automation templates that file action items into a project tracker.
